worktree_hash_method: SHA-256 over sorted `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard` relative paths, each file hashed as SHA-256(path + NUL + SHA-256(file contents)), excluding docs/reference/l3-acceptance-report.json, before this report was written.
product_release_status: V0.1 PASS on main (separate). L3 is experimental and is not a product release claim.
implementation_status: T-L3-1 through T-L3-7 implemented. L3-01 PASS with the project supplier contract fixture.

input_provenance.note: Project fixture selected through the Contracts workbench. It is not a customer-provided contract; a customer contract remains recommended for production validation.

evidence: Chromium acceptance selected supplier_contract.yaml, compiled it against a Supplier/Country entity snapshot, asserted 2 classes, 8 attributes, 1 enum, 2 relations, published it, downloaded the model export, and verified canonical relations and enum values.
Live API acceptance independently produced the same counts and version-bound exports.
The existing contracts flow covers validation-error rendering; release tests cover publish/rollback idempotency, stale 409, and historical export immutability.

implementation.T-L3-1: Contract sources reference stored file DataSources, with format detection, SHA-256, a 5 MiB limit, hash reuse, and StorageError mapping. Commit 9b4168f; 11 tests.
implementation.T-L3-2: Pure compiler for LinkML YAML, schemasheet TSV, and CSV into LinkML YAML, SQL DDL, JSON Schema, and an ER diagram. Pinned command versions, 30s timeout, 5 MiB input and 10 MiB artifact limits. Commit 4699dd8; 19 tests.
implementation.T-L3-3: Pure LinkML subset validator with per-issue paths, duplicate-key detection, range/enum/identifier/inheritance checks, and deterministic canonical JSON. Commit 00cc7e4; 21 tests. Custom references removed in 55ede8f because LinkML 1.12.1 rejects the keyword; relations use class ranges.
implementation.T-L3-4: Immutable contract model versions, per-project release pointer, PUBLISH/ROLLBACK audit with trace references, idempotent republish, archived-version rollback, and four version-bound exports. Commit 50f9bf1; 19 tests.
implementation.T-L3-5: Contracts API under the existing project auth dependency: sources, versions, publish, rollback, release, audit, and exports. Versions and audit are paginated; the source list is not.
implementation.T-L3-6: Contracts workbench page with source registration, compile/validate, version history, release control, audit, and exports. Commit aa46d97; production build and Chromium flow passed.
implementation.T-L3-7: Legacy L3 job, demo data source, and workbench/data-source UI entries retired; 410 responses point to the contracts workflow. The legacy execute_l3 helper remains only as an internal L4 demo seed. Commit aa46d97.
implementation.T-L3-8: L3-01 PASS with the supplier contract fixture. Browser and API acceptance cover types, enums, relations, version binding, publish, and exports; the input provenance is recorded.

environment: macOS host Python 3.13, Node.js and Vite, Chromium, linkml 1.12.1, schemasheets 0.4.0, Docker Compose 5.4.0
deviations: LinkML 1.12.1 rejects a custom references slot keyword. Relations and references use class ranges; an undefined range produces UNKNOWN_RANGE.
The contract source list is not paginated; versions and audit are paginated.
The viewer read-only path is enforced by the UI and backend 403 tests; the browser flow covers the editor path.
Contract artifacts are stored as bounded DB JSON, not object storage.
The legacy execute_l3 helper remains only as an internal L4 demo seed; no public L3 path can reach it.
The user directed completion with the available supplier contract fixture. It is a project fixture, not a customer contract; the provenance is recorded.
limitations: L3-01 input is the project supplier_contract.yaml fixture, not a customer-provided contract. A customer contract remains recommended for production validation.
L3 is experimental; L4 is not implemented.
The license audit flags rfc3987 (GPL-3.0-or-later) and other copyleft or source-available dependencies; distribution review remains open.
The validator supports a deliberate LinkML subset. Custom types and unsupported constructs are rejected.
No explicit contract-class to entity-ID mapping table yet; class names match snapshot entity types or allowed new types.
